source_boundary.note: Lower-rung source-faithful Python oracle. Product source is unchanged; no release credit.

randomized_success_merge.property: direct live add_content state equals staged-per-hash overlay merged after success, including pre-existing candidates, hints, exact-Deflate identities and counts

randomized_failure_isolation.property: discarding staged state after failure leaves live candidate state byte/semantic identical

real_zip_success.property: recipe object and final candidate state exactly equal under direct versus transactional callback semantics

real_zip_late_failure.shape: first ZIP_STORED member aliases a pre-existing live raw hash; later ZIP_BZIP2 member forces recipe None
real_zip_late_failure.current_behavior: direct callback mutates the live candidate by adding the staged member hint before failure
real_zip_late_failure.transactional_behavior: live state remains unchanged; staged side effects are discarded

memory_hostile.shape: 1000 pre-existing unique 64KiB candidates replayed as fresh duplicate byte objects
memory_hostile.result: The overlay should reuse already-owned live raw/Deflate byte objects when a staged hash/stream already exists.

disposition.mark_and_sweep: NARROWED: useful only as defense-in-depth for unreachable physical blobs; cannot undo speculative mutation on already-reachable hashes.
disposition.transaction_overlay: ADVANCE: exact success semantics + failure isolation established at lower evidence rung.
disposition.next: Land product helper plus focused tests; then same-source product archive bytes/tree/RSS/wall A/B. Keep exception/fallback law unchanged.
